style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the strip wears milk-chocolate pieces, so the keys are chocolate brown with a raspberry Enter, butter-caramel soft keys and a cream panel (the owner's ch 5 pick); never red, never violet.

images.why: Description 'Cut one whole into ten equal parts, shade some of them'; Look 'A long strip lying across the stage with a cutter along it'; Stage 'A settled strip shows ten pieces of one length ... touching along their edges' and 'Measure the pieces lifts all ten off the strip'. A strip the child cuts into equal parts with no material named in the picture words: one chocolate piece, drawn once per piece by the tool.
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate in a warm milk-chocolate brown, with a glossy top, a soft bevelled edge and a gentle highlight in one corner.

images.why: Owner 2026-10-15: the strip named 'ribbon' looks like a real ribbon. One opaque strip picture covers the whole 1080 x 150 strip; each piece shows its own section (clipPath), so ten pieces read as one ribbon and a lifted piece as a piece of it. Burgundy, not gold or pink (amber = tenths, rose = hundredths).
images.prompt: A long straight length of deep burgundy-brown satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth glossy sheen that glows softly along its length.

images.why: Owner 2026-10-15: the strip named 'chapati' looks like a real chapati. Same strip method as the ribbon; a shaded chapati piece needs a non-colour cue (ink outline) because amber over golden chapati is low contrast.
images.prompt: A long flat length of freshly made wheat chapati in a warm golden-brown, with a soft matte surface scattered all over with small light-brown toasted spots.
